A.S.G.I., C.S.C. 
Mehilal vs Union Of India And 2 Others on 26 September, 2025
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68929497/
1

Court No. - 29
 Hon'Ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi, J. 
Hon'Ble Anish Kumar Gupta, J.

1. Heard Sri Aditya Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Devesh Vikara, learned
Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State respondents.

2. The instant writ petition has been filed seeking following reliefs:-
"(i) issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus to direct, Respondent
No. 2/3 to provide reasonable compensation as per his share, permissible under law
along with admissible interest in regard to the Plot No. 676 area 0.0190 hectare m,
678 area 0.0050 hectare m, 679 area 0.0050 hectare m, 683 area 0.0200 hectare m,
584 area 0.0290 hectare m, situated in Village-Gohora, P/O-Ramdayalganj,
Tahsil-Sadar, District-Jaunpur.
(ii) issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the
authority concerned to consider, grievances of petitioner according to law."

3.  At the outset, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel has submitted that the land had been acquired under the National Highways Act and in lieu of award, due compensation has already been deposited with the Special Land Acquisition Officer (in short "SLAO").
He submits that the Authority has no objection, in case the petitioner approaches to the concerned SLAO, along with requisite documents, for disbursement of the same.

4. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits of the issue, the writ petition stands disposed of with observation that in case, the petitioner approaches to the SLAO within two weeks along with the requisite documents claiming compensation over which he has absolute right, title and claim, the same shall be considered and decided in accordance with law and in case the claim is sustainable and there is no other legal impediment, the amount shall be released forthwith.

(Anish Kumar Gupta,J.) (Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.) September 26, 2025 Kirti  Mehilal vs Union Of India And 2 Others on 26 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68929497/
